events.content:
This is a Next.js 16 app using `cacheComponents` (Partial Prerendering). Right now `app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx` fetches the title and the slow details (`getProjectDetails` has an 800ms delay) together inside one `Suspense` boundary, so the whole thing is one dynamic hole — prefetch can't produce anything faster than the "Loading project..." fallback, and the slow details always get pulled in too.

Splitting the title into its own `Suspense` boundary, separate from the details, lets PPR treat the title as static (it's cheap/cached, so it resolves during prefetch and ships in the static shell) while the details boundary stays a dynamic hole that only fetches on actual navigation.
